# Deep Learning

Connect each architectural concept to data, objective, computation, and
failure modes. Do not jump to frameworks before explaining the underlying
mechanics.

## Foundations

- Neurons, perceptrons, layers, and network parameters.
- Activation functions and forward propagation.
- Loss functions, gradients, and backpropagation.
- Gradient descent, optimizers, and regularization.

## Architectures

- Convolutional neural networks (CNNs).
- Recurrent neural networks (RNNs) and LSTMs.
- Attention mechanisms and Transformers.
- Transfer learning and fine-tuning.

## Practice and evaluation

- Work through a tiny numerical example before using a library.
- Explain tensor shapes, training loops, and validation.
- Discuss compute and data requirements, overfitting, and reproducibility.
- Compare a simple baseline with a neural approach and justify the added cost.
